notes: This contract records a portable C++ TCK check for RTIambassador::setRangeBounds and its HLAreportServiceInvocation delivery through the standard MIM. It verifies the accepted lower/upper values again with GetRangeBounds after CommitRegionModifications, directly exercising the current range set by Set Range Bounds under clause 10.28 (the general region operation also relates to clause 9.1.2). Successful service invocation reporting and interaction content map to clauses 11.5 and 11.5.1. The scenario establishes a valid one-dimension region range with reporting disabled, enables MOM reporting, calls SetRangeBounds, and checks the exact supplied Region/Dimension handles and lower/upper values, standard null return marker, success and empty-exception fields, serial zero, region service type 5, reliable delivery, and inherited HLAfederate reporter identity. It rejects a lower-greater-than-upper update as InvalidRangeBound, verifies the accepted range remains current after committing, and checks the corresponding failure report. It also calls SetRangeBounds with a valid dimension absent from the region and with a default-invalid RegionHandle; it checks RegionDoesNotContainSpecifiedDimension and InvalidRegion, respectively, plus exact failed-service-report arguments, serials, and reporter identity. Finally, it commits a region owned by the observer, verifies that the subject receives the API-declared RegionNotCreatedByThisFederate exception when calling SetRangeBounds with that region, and checks the matching failure report. The absent-dimension, invalid-region, and foreign-owner negative paths are supplemental and add no immutable requirement mappings. It does not assert file-report behavior or region-based routing. The source uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard 1516.2 MIM data elements, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, model FOM and configured dimension, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration.

api_surfaces.owner: IEEE 1516.1 C++ API and IEEE 1516.2 standard MIM
api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador::createRegion(DimensionHandleSet), RTIambassador::setRangeBounds(RegionHandle, DimensionHandle, RangeBounds), RTIambassador::commitRegionModifications(RegionHandleSet), RTIambassador::getRangeBounds(RegionHandle, DimensionHandle), RTIambassador::setServiceReportingSwitch(Boolean), and FederateAmbassador::receiveInteraction for HLAreportServiceInvocation
